data.description: Any creature sexually attracted to women runs the risk of being beguiled by a nereid if it looks upon her beauty from a distance of 30 feet or less.  If the creature fails a DC %1 Will save, it is immediately fascinated.  A nereid may use her suggestion spell-like ability at will against creatures that are fascinated by her beguiling aura.  This is a mind-affecting compulsion effect.
data.name: Beguiling Aura
